title: Uncle Pete's Cabin ~ Rockhaven
description:
A picturesque, quiet and private 75 acre ranch that is complimented with extreme attention to detail.  You like the photos?  The real thing is even better!  This is country living at its finest.

This rental is a renovated Civil War Era Log Cabin with all modern amenities.

Whether you're enjoying a tranquil morning coffee overlooking the beautiful Nashville countryside complete grazing horses or luxuriating in the indoor whirlpool tub - this property exudes peaceful relaxation and romance.
